reviewCharts.sourceCoverage: Clark County, Washoe County, and Humboldt County official CVR precinct rows are loaded; the other 14 Nevada jurisdictions remain county-only until local exports or records-request productions are collected. Wave 24 adds generated jurisdiction-specific request packets for the remaining counties.
reviewCharts.warning: Nevada review rows now include Clark County, Washoe County, and Humboldt County official CVR precinct President-versus-U.S. Senate rows. The rest of Nevada remains county-level statewide-results context, and county CVR totals may differ from certified county totals, so statewide conclusions still require source-row inspection and additional county local exports or request-packet responses.

turnout.notes: Nevada turnout rows use EAC 2024 V2 county/jurisdiction fallback rows until a state-native turnout artifact is collected. A July 1, 2026 source pass found that the archived NVSOS statewide result page lacks turnout/registration markers and live NVSOS turnout/registration pages returned Incapsula challenge pages or empty responses from scripted access.

historicalBaselines.warning: Nevada historical baseline rows are county-level presidential results from 2012, 2016, and 2020 Wikipedia county tables with state-source footnotes. Use them as contextual baseline rows, not as 2024 certified data.
